notes.title: VonGarland Castle : Beyond Blood demo is out now!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=hi2uggEMA9Q;full][/previewyoutube]


Follow and wishlist [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3578290/VonGarland_Castle__Beyond_Blood/]VonGarland Castle : Beyond Blood[/url]

First build of the demo is up!
[b]The demo includes the first chapter
4 Bosses
4 puzzles 
lots of pickups and enemies.
lots of lore and easter eggs.
5 unlockable achievements [/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45536173/aebf69006f7740eb5ac99a65522467851162ab3a.jpg[/img]

I really hope people will post thoughts and feedback! I would love to know if I should make enemies and/or puzzles easier or harder and any other thoughts people have.

also if you reach the chapter end you will see your stats displayed :
bullets fired, enemies killed, saves and health used.
feel free to post these stats in the community, I would love to try to get a over all average in order to set up the scoring system and see what kind of stats should earn the precious S rank :)


[h2]a few of the things in the works for the full game and demo:[/h2]
full map functionality / Map region pickups.
Display of full play time on your save file + at each chapter end.
SFXs/voice work for the shop owner/captain on the boat.
more SFXs for the bone head enemies.
more enemy types.
new music by Fredrik Rojas the composer of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2582300/VonGarland_Castle__Sacrilege_of_the_Night/]VonGarland castle : sacrilege of the night[/url].
semi mappable controls, right now I have kind of mirrored Metroid Dread / RE4 controls, so I think they work pretty well but I am working on customization options.
extra move guides into in the select menu, 3 things you can do that are not currently explained anywhere 
Press and hold up then press attack while in the air to do a cool Jump attack (this will have more effect soon, right now it just looks cool)
Press the action button (B) while sprinting to do a slide, good for dodging and getting through crawl spaces quickly.
use the D-pad to quick select guns & close combat weapons. 
[b]Unlockable costumes! [/b]
there will be some outfits that are clear nods to RE titles along with some over fun ones
(there are also many unlockable jackets which effect Ransoms over all stats(and style))
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45536173/fbe806551fe589d20f8a5221592111d573fc5938.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45536173/c13c61fdfd6a3214b8b291d4c695f16596c1f3d0.png[/img]

and please if you haven't already wishlist and follow! it helps a lot 

Thanks much 
-Ash

notes.title: return to VonGarland Castle
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=hi2uggEMA9Q;full][/previewyoutube]

the trailer for the next game in the VonGarland Castle series is now live! 
[b]VonGarland Castle : Beyond Blood[/b]

This takes place 100s of years after the events of the first game, you play as Ransom VonGarland as she returns to VonGarland castle to uncover why the Plasmadine corporation has set up laboratories in and around the castle.
while VonGarland Sacrilege of the Night was a love letter to the classic Castlevania's VCBB is the merging of Super Metroid/ a Metroidvania and the resident evil series (more of my all time favorite games)
I really just wanted to see what a mix of Super Metroid and RE4 would look like, so I started building this :)

hopefully you can check it out and wishlist it if it looks like something that might interest you!
as always thanks for playing my games. if you have questions drop them here or at my [url=https://x.com/MonsterRobotGC]X[/url]

notes.title: First large update!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=zqlEIGhE-lM;full][/previewyoutube]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44577294/e41d764065e0ccab4fc83515036d5959f7c9b43d.png[/img][b]First major update. [/b]


[u][b]make sure you start a new game file after updating, old save files will not work on this update.[/b][/u]

[b]*rebuilt every level from the ground up, they are fully redesigned (and I hope they flow better :)
*added fast running & 8 direction aiming 
* Now you start with the Alchemy gun and can switch between that and the whip at any time.
*added mech suits to some of the levels (like mega man X)
* the crumbling catacombs are now The Clock Tower. Drizzle coast now ends with a ghost ship in place of the lighthouse.
*added many new enemy types
*added the Revenger, a super move you can fire once the Revenger meter is full, you build it up by collecting Fiend Shards after you kill enemies or when you take damage. and there are now 6 hidden items that change your Revenger attack type.
*added health viles/ E-tanks there are 5 of those hidden within the game, each one boosts your health by 10. 
*removed the storage bin, now you automatically keep all your gold and items, you only lose alchemy cells & treasures when you die or quit the game. 
*added better lighting and effects to all levels so hopefully the visuals are a bit nicer now
*Check points are now triggered a doors throughout the levels, so if you die you aren't forced to backtrack too far
* you no longer have limited lives 
*added settings to in-game pause menu so you can change the music vol. You can also now turn on/off auto meat, which will automatically use meat(if you have any) to restore health when you have low HP
*location of all charms and items have been changed around.[/b]

notes.title: Castle Ghoulacard Update
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=3eLIT5WLkJw;full][/previewyoutube]

The VonGarland Castle big update is coming along! 
this update will be essentially a entire new game which will be selectable from the start screen once it goes live

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44577294/cb80bec5869c94b579ddd0cea4befa90034ec67c.png[/img]

The Castle will contain well over 100 rooms to explore.
new enemies and items and power-ups including:

The ManaTech Whip:
there are a total of 5 ManaTech Upgrades to be found
*Fire 
*Frost 
*Electric
*Faze 
*Holy 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44577294/abe7f5bf4ae47004521609ee001a4220760c1e9f.png[/img]

these magic whips allow you to open locked doors, destroy objects and effect enemies within the castle, some enemies are weak to certain Mana types. also if you hold your whip charge with the Frost Mana Equipped you can guard from extreme heat, and likewise you can do the reverse with the Heat Mana equipped

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44577294/a71f465c002114c5d256a983477c8c9216a32db5.png[/img]

*Speed Greaves
Allow you to run at super speed to cross quick breaking bridges/etc. 

*Steam Knuckles
the Steam Knuckles allow you smash through some walls as well as climb on SteamRails once you have upgraded them. 

*Grapple Whip 
The GrappleWhip allows you to hook onto any wall and pull some objects to you.

*Armors 
new armors allow you to resist extreme heat and cold and to move through water more easily. 

there are other items as well + you will now be able to attack with your whip or Alchemy Gun in 8 directions. I'll be posting a more comprehensive video about the update soon! 

Please feel free to post any thoughts or questions

Thanks for supporting VonGarland Castle 
-Ash 
-Monster Robot Studios-

notes.title: Small Update 12/18/23
notes.content:
[b]update notes[/b]

After watching some more people play the game/more feedback I have made some more small adjustments.

[url=https://pbs.twimg.com/media/GBL2kAMWkAAQgVr?format=jpg&name=4096x4096][img]https://pbs.twimg.com/media/GBL2kAMWkAAQgVr?format=jpg&name=4096x4096[/img][/url]
a look at some of the new enemies 

[url=https://www.reddit.com/r/VonGarlandCastle/comments/18ls8qw/lots_of_new_enemies_coming_manatech_whip/]you can also view some of the new enemies and ManaTech Whip testing on the VonGarland Subreddit [/url]

more pop up icons appear in the intro level to help better show how to execute the whip pull and rip. 
whip pull now takes less time to max out/trigger.
moving through doors now moves faster. 
blocks that you can whip-lock to now have larger hit boxes so you don't need to be as precise. 
"Flyball" enemies that chase you now have larger hit boxes so are less tricky to kill. 
removed the "Whip Bone" enemy from intro level to help make it easier for beginners, also lowered hp of some of the other foes in the intro area. 
the player now emits a bit more light to pop out/stand out better on screen. 

more updates coming soon! 
thanks for playing :) 
and if you feel inclined please leave a review, it helps a ton

-Ash

notes.title: Small Update 12/10/23
notes.content:
Hi all,

The game should now support wide screen aspect ratios such as  3440X1440 2560 X1080
small bug fixes & language corrections. 
many small aesthetic changes have been made to all levels just to give them a slightly better look.
crank doors now have gears & chains that spin/move when you operate them to give players more visual feedback.
more foliage and other touches have been added to levels, nicer looking windows have been added to some level backgrounds, etc.

Duke, Val and Silvago all now have slightly different walking and running speed and whip charge speed. 
[b]Duke Slowest moving with fastest Whip Charge.
Silvago medium moving and Whip Charge. 
Val fastest moving and slowest Whip Charge.[/b]
(the differences are very slight so it won't impact too much based on who you play as)


thanks to everyone who has been playing and giving feedback and reporting bugs.
I will keep up the small updates while working towards the big update.  
if you have time to leave a review and is super helpful

and if you find more bugs/issues post them here 
https://steamcommunity.com/app/2582300/discussions/0/3955910352554794937/
and I will get to them as quick as I can

Thanks all
 more soon
 -Ash

notes.title: The Alchemy Flute
notes.content:
one of the items/weapons you can unlock is the Alchemy Flute. 
once you have the flute and sheet music(which can be found in various locations) you can learn new songs from Rojas, playing the right song in the right place can unlock hidden areas/move walls/etc. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44577294/cd51ebd704fa1eebe3ed1513a32fb8feede24296.png[/img]


like all things in VonGarland Castle these extras will help you complete the game more easily, but are not required. The game can always be played like a classic mega man or Castlevania, meaning you can just beat each level and boss in order to beat the game. but there are loads of extras for anyone who is willing to take the time to find them :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44577294/445ce3044a02044e10425f2fd05450717bc1e277.png[/img]

as always thanks for reading! 
if you know folks you think might enjoy the game feel free to tell them to give it a wishlist and follow :) 

-Ash
